apps.name: Achilló
apps.subtitle: Guided Achilles rehab, by ear
apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Phone cue sounds (the plucks, breaths and 3-2-1) are about three times louder at every volume setting. The voice is unchanged.

Watch: the background session that keeps taps going with the screen off is now retried whenever you raise your wrist, and the watch tells you ("Taps pause when the screen sleeps") if it is not running.

Watch cues redesigned: one big hit on the push, a faint heartbeat through the hold, a thud-and-fall on the release, and a 3-2-1 at the end of holds. The screen flashes white on push and release. Taps uses Apple's strongest patterns on Strong and Max.
